name: Park Hotels & Resorts
reason: Leveraged hotel REIT (net debt/EBITDA 6.7x) with FFO at 0.67x its 2018 level, 10y revenue CAGR -0.6% and 10y ROIC 2.6% - cyclical lodging with no growth route or specialness.

name: Packaging Corporation of America
reason: Well-run containerboard producer but earnings are set by commodity box/linerboard prices and volumes (EPS fell 24% in 2020 and 22% in 2023); cyclical commodity paper, not forecastable 5-10 years out.

name: ePlus
reason: Low-margin IT value-added reseller (EBIT margin 6.8%) with EPS at 1.0x 10y max and FCF swinging with working capital (LTM FCF yield -5% vs NTM 6.4%); FY2-3 consensus +9%/-3% - cheap but not special.

name: PPL Corp
reason: Regulated utility with negative FCF (capex > CFO, FCF yield -9%), net debt/EBITDA 5.1x and 10y EPS CAGR -2.0%; ~7.8% LTG depends on rate-base growth funded by external capital - no specialness.

name: People Inc (ex-IAC)
reason: Holding company of publishing (Dotdash Meredith) plus Angi/Care.com with negative EPS in 3 of last 4 years, 10y ROIC -2.3% and search-traffic dependence exposed to AI disintermediation.

name: Primoris Services
reason: Specialty contractor with EPS at 1.0x 10y max and EBIT margin at 10y high (5.5%) on a renewables/power construction boom; thin-margin project work with acq_to_fcf 1.11 and consensus FY1 EPS -62%.

name: Public Storage
reason: Best-in-class self-storage REIT with a scale moat, but FFO is flat since 2022 (16.89 to 16.97), 10y FFO CAGR 6.8%, LTG 3.4% and FY2-3 consensus -2%/+4% - fails the 7% growth route.

name: PTC Therapeutics
reason: Rare-disease biotech that turned profitable only in 2025 (EPS 7.78 after a decade of losses) largely on a one-off licensing upfront (Novartis votoplam deal); pipeline and label outcomes are binary and consensus FY1 EPS -85%.

name: Patterson-UTI Energy
reason: Oilfield drilling/frac services with earnings set by oil and gas prices and rig counts; negative EPS in 8 of last 11 years and 10y shares CAGR +10% from acquisitions.

name: Peloton Interactive
reason: Connected-fitness hardware/subscription business with shrinking revenue, only first positive EPS in FY2026 (0.14) after cumulative losses and 10y ROIC avg -35%; FCF comes from cost cuts not durable economics.

name: QUALCOMM
reason: EPS at 0.96x 10y max in a cyclical handset chip market, with a credible single-customer threat (Apple in-house modem roll-off) and China/licensing litigation risk within 5 years; LTG 6.1%.

name: Restaurant Brands International
reason: Franchisor with decent brands but net debt/EBITDA 5.2x, 10y ROIC 5.0%, EBIT margin falling to a 10y low (26.5% vs 42% peak) and Burger King US franchisee distress - leverage-driven, not special.

name: Q2 Holdings
reason: Sticky digital-banking software but only became GAAP-profitable in 2025 (EBIT margin 5.7%), adj-vs-GAAP gap ~220% from SBC, shares +5.7%/yr and acq_to_fcf 2.7x - too early to forecast through-cycle earnings.

name: RB Global
reason: Growth has been acquisition-driven (IAA deal; acq_to_fcf 1.34x, shares +5.7%/yr, ROIC 7.3%) with EBIT margin down from 32% to 17.8% and adj-vs-GAAP gap ~77%; salvage auto volumes tied to insurance/used-car cycle.

name: Reddit
reason: First profitable year only in 2025 (EBIT margin 20%) with heavy dependence on Google search traffic and AI data-licensing deals; user/ad trajectory cannot be forecast with confidence 5-10 years out.

name: Rexford Industrial Realty
reason: SoCal infill industrial REIT whose FFO growth came from equity-funded acquisitions (shares +15.7%/yr, 10y ROIC 2.2%) with net debt/EBITDA 4.6x, FFO flat at 2.40 and consensus FY1-2 sharply negative as market rents fall.

name: Royal Gold
reason: Excellent royalty/stream model but earnings are set by the gold price: EPS and EBIT margin (64.5%) at 10y highs (EPS 1.0x 10y max) after a sharp metal-price run-up, and 10y FCF conversion -0.14 from stream purchases.

name: Robert Half
reason: Staffing firm with EPS at 0.22x 10y max and margin collapsing to 1.4% as white-collar temp demand falls; credible AI disintermediation threat to accounting/admin contract talent within 5 years.

name: Resolute Holdings Management
reason: Recently spun-out (2024) manager whose consolidated earnings are CompoSecure metal payment cards; only 2 years of history (EPS -0.27, -0.69), no consensus estimates and a fee/control structure that is hard to underwrite.

name: Ryman Hospitality Properties
reason: Gaylord group-convention hotel REIT: unique assets but cyclical lodging (FFO -140% in 2020), net debt/EBITDA 4.7x, 10y FFO CAGR 4.8% and EBIT margin near 10y high - fails the recession and growth tests.
